title: Account Security
subtitle: Manage your credentials and monitor account access to ensure maximum protection of your data.

privacy_card.title: Privacy First
privacy_card.description: HOGU will never share your password. If you notice suspicious activity, change your credentials immediately.

personal_data.title: Personal Data
personal_data.subtitle: Update your name and billing address.

email.title: Email Address
email.subtitle: Manage the email for notifications and login.
email.verification_notice: We will send a verification link to the new address.

password.title: Reset Password
password.subtitle: We recommend using a strong password.

delete_account.title: Delete Account
delete_account.subtitle: Irreversible actions on your account.
delete_account.warning_description: Once the account is deleted, your personal data will be anonymized. This action cannot be undone.
delete_account.provider_warning: Also, offered services and uploaded documents will be disabled.
delete_account.modal_description: This action is final. Your profile will be deleted and you will no longer be able to log in with these credentials.
delete_account.modal_data_notice: Past activities and bookings will be kept anonymously.
delete_account.modal_provider_alert: WARNING: All offered services will be marked as deleted and documents invalidated.

profile_updated.message: Your personal data has been successfully updated.
